serving.notes: The text prompt is on the parent card. This card has no generation example. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; model_max_length there is 1010000. config.json max_position_embeddings is 262144, which matches the parent card's context length. The package defines a helper system string for writing training answers; train.py then builds each example as a user message only. generation_config.json has no max_new_tokens or repetition_penalty. Hub safetensors total is 4,022,468,096 parameters. Before the merge, the script multiplies the LoRA scale by strength 1.25.

evaluation_reported.text: depresso.json records a 12-prompt test: mean_mood 2.36, one upbeat ending, mean length 258 characters. The project page says guardrails, safety behaviour, and answer quality are largely the same as the base model.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is blank. The training script is supervised next-token training of a LoRA adapter, rank 16 and alpha 32, then merge_and_unload. The dataset file name and the parent match the inventory.
